title: Keyboard parity with Chrome: Cmd-K clears a terminal but opens the chat search elsewhere; Cmd-T, Cmd-W, Cmd-Shift-T, Esc, Cmd-1, Cmd-comma and Cmd-Shift-N do what a person expects
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal with keyboard focus at its prompt
converted from scripts/cmux-next/keyboard-parity-e2e.py (cited fix #19870), which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

expect.noReceiptReason: typed text goes to the shell; it runs no action

steps.note: the script's marker line: the terminal shows text that Cmd-K must clear
matrix cell terminal x Cmd-K: terminal.clear; the screen loses the marker and no palette opens
matrix cell terminal x Cmd-T: a new tab with the New Tab page, focused
matrix cell newtab x Cmd-K, the cited fix (#19870): outside a terminal Cmd-K runs agentPane.searchChats and the palette opens

expect.noReceiptReason: Escape closes the palette in its own key handler; the key router names no action

steps.note: matrix row Esc: the palette closes and the keyboard returns to the New Tab page
matrix row Cmd-W: the focused tab (the New Tab page) closes, with no question
matrix row Cmd-Shift-T: the tab closed just before comes back
a second workspace on its New Tab page, so Cmd-1 moves the selection (the script's filler items)
matrix row Cmd-1: selectWorkspaceByNumber selects the sidebar's first item
matrix row Cmd-comma: Settings opens as a page tab and takes focus
matrix row Cmd-Shift-N: a new window

debug.focus lists the window controllers in creation order (WindowManager.controllers), so windows/1/id is the window Cmd-Shift-N made, the id debug.key's window param takes (the script reads the same list)

Close Window sent to the new window: debug.key makes it the key window for the dispatch, so closeWindow closes it, as the script closes the window it made; with no window debug.key would pick the launch window

invariants: terminals at terminal-cmd-k differ from marked in last24Sha256 and overlays.palette.open stays false: Cmd-K in a terminal clears it, never opens the chat search
focus.context at page-cmd-k has terminal false and overlays.palette.open true: Cmd-K outside a terminal opens the chat search (#19870)
focus at palette-closed equals focus at new-tab-page: Esc gives the keyboard back to the New Tab page
the tab reopen-page brought back is the New Tab page close-page closed, and history at reopened no longer lists it
focus at settings resolves to the Settings page tab

windows at end equal those at second-workspace's settled checkpoint; the window id window-ids read at windows/1 is not in windows at end and the one at windows/0 is: the window Cmd-Shift-N made is gone and the launch window stays
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the web page and agent chat composer focus targets of the matrix: the case is offline with no loopback web fixture in driver_app yet (fixture.web), and the composer column needs a started chat (debug.agent_pane)

Cmd-L, Cmd-F, Cmd-R, Cmd-[ and Cmd-] from every focus target: their effects (the address bar or New Tab field, a find bar in a page, history moves) need the web fixture or are read only through debug.key's last interception, which no facet records
Cmd-9 (the last item) and Cmd-I (a new agent chat) and the Settings and sidebar focus columns
the script's real keys through cua-driver: the case presses keys through debug.key, the app's own key path
